title: Are we too reliant on technology? Questions arise after Microsoft's widespread outages
summary: This week's Microsoft outage highlighted the risks of relying on a single technology provider for essential services. contentText: This week's Microsoft outage highlighted the risks of relying on a single technology provider for essential services. The disruption lasted nearly 24 hours, impacting millions of users across more than 70 countries – from government agencies to airlines to hospitals and small businesses. Are we too reliant on technology? Analysis by Marcel Saucet, research associate at the University of San Diego School of Law.
